mentions.name: Codebase Explainability Snapshot Tool
mentions.description: A codebase explainability tool that has an LLM produce a navigable snapshot of what is going on in a project, going a step deeper than text-only "teach me this project" explanations. It aims to preserve comprehension as code generation scales, exploring a scalable, LLM-accelerated bottom-up approach after big-bang LLM prototypes underperformed even with large wishlists and guidance.
mentions.problem: Text alone is too limited for codebase comprehension, and comprehension tends to be given up as code generation scales.
mentions.source_excerpt: My side project is now codebase explainability. I basically don't buy the premise that we just have to give up on comprehension as code generation scales; I just think that text is too limited by itself. So going a step deeper than asking Claudex "teach me this project", but having it produce a navigable snapshot of what's going on.
